metadata.llm_reason: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill for real-time CLS observation during active user interaction using DevTools live metrics. It differs semantically from peer candidates: 'Distinguish Lab vs. Field CLS Measurement' (comparative analysis, not observation), 'Web Font Rendering Strategy Selection' (font-specific mitigation, not diagnosis), and 'Identify Third-Party Content Control Constraints' (constraint assessment, not measurement). It also differs from existing skills which focus on image/link optimization, not CLS diagnosis. The candidate addresses a specific investigation technique (live metrics monitoring) that is not covered by existing registry and has valid support evidence.
